verdict.rationale: Column's docs say you can programmatically open and manage FDIC-insured bank accounts (FBO, sweep, clearing, custom) on behalf of customers, with KYC/KYB available through Column or your own process. They also say every route is sandboxed with data persisting like production, using separate sandbox and live API keys and simulation endpoints for funding. Missing for 10: documented application-to-active lifecycle (statuses and transitions, including how manual KYC review affects programmatic activation), and independent or hands-on corroboration of account opening via the API.
